keyFindings.description: When every occurrence refuses the mark, mutation.go:646-655 reports the refusal of the last occurrence NearestFirst lists, the farthest one. The deep review's probe: an ask's quote copied to the front matter (nearest) and to a code block (farther) got the 400 'would land in a code block'; an uploader who removes the code block is refused again for the front matter. Report the first (nearest) refusal, the one Find would have anchored at, or name every refused place; add a test.

QuoteFinder.FindDiscardingMiss (find.go:164-170) and find's describeMiss flag have no production caller left; ReplaceText was the only one. Delete both, drop their reanchor_test.go cases, and point AGENTS.md:2415, the pr2447 solutions note and the NearestFirst doc comment at NearestFirst.

The nearest-then-earlier rule exists twice: NearestFirst's comparator (find.go:188-193) and find's near loop (find.go:247-257). Write one comparator; find's near branch becomes slices.MinFunc with it, so 'Find with near returns NearestFirst's first' holds by construction.

The tie assertion at find_test.go:1006 runs only when the gap between the first two matches is even, and the fixture's gap is 11, so it never runs. Use a fixture with an exact tie and assert it every time.

The changelog said any copy into a code block keeps the anchor on the original; for a comment or suggestion a code block carries the mark. Fixed by the reviewer (prose only), scoped to where the anchor cannot stand.

accepted: Round-3 findings fixed in 090ae14d: the copy case re-anchors at the nearest allowed occurrence (deep review: deleting the skip loop fails both copy tests), reanchorError is one decision returning a plain ErrDocSchema for server faults (removing that branch fails its test), and Place() owns the wording. The forward merge 84001a00 is correct: a three-way merge reproduces it, and the README row is main's with the PR's sentence appended. Not a defect: extracting the occurrence loop from ReplaceText (readability; the behaviour is tested).
ci: CI run 40911247197 at code head 090ae14d was queued at 16:24Z; the PR is MERGEABLE again. My prose push starts a new run. A change request does not wait on CI.
thermonuclear: Run once at 090ae14d: deep review approve with three minors (farthest place named, vacuous tie test, changelog breadth); code quality: dead FindDiscardingMiss, duplicated comparator, loop structure, vacuous tie test. The reviewer raised 'farthest place named' to important: the message sends the uploader to a second refusal.
